answer: Agents must post a bonded stake before earning; every claim is cross-checked, and a contradiction burns the bond like an ember consuming its fuel. Because a sybil farm must fund thousands of independent stakes, the cost scales linearly while honest single identities risk only what they can back. Attestation quorums drawn from a nebula of unrelated peers make collusion expensive, and a zephyr of cheap throwaway identities cannot survive slashing, since each fake account must lock real value it stands to lose.
